aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because the changed factor is a filename and key baseline/test rows are not cited or grouped correctly.
issues: Changed factor is not evidence-based; it should reflect Yoke class/test condition, not the file name.
Baseline and changed conditions are marked unknown despite visible Normal and Total Test Class rows.
Outcome statistics cite mostly header rows instead of the data rows supporting counts and NG rates.
Yoke class distribution and function NG results are mixed without clear grouping keys.
Review title and purpose include pipe artifacts and unclean text.
requiredUserQuestions: Should the primary comparison be Normal vs Total Test Class, or Class 1 vs Class 2 vs Class 3?
correctionPlan: Replace changedFactor with the actual tested Yoke class/test-condition comparison.
Set baseline and test conditions from cited data rows, including Normal and Total Test Class where applicable.
Cite data rows for class counts and function results, not only section headers.
Separate or clearly subgroup Yoke class distribution and function NG/hearing outcomes.
Clean title, purpose, metric names, and remove extraction artifacts.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Current citations prove row existence but are insufficient as final evidence because most metrics cite headers rather than supporting data rows.
